OR91ee072153d89e82.content: On September 30, 1925, Baldev Das executed a mortgage bond for Rs 16,000 in favor of Mst. Naraini and Talok Chand for joint family movable properties.

participants.role: Father and manager of joint Hindu family

OR91ee072153d89e82.event: Mortgage bond executed securing loan against joint family properties.
OR91ee072153d89e82.procedure_and_court: Private transaction; no court proceeding at this stage.

OR9217d22d06d5a113.content: On April 16, 1928, appellants filed suit for partition against their father Baldev Das; final decree for partition passed on July 20, 1928.

participants.role: Father and defendant in partition suit

OR9217d22d06d5a113.event: Partition suit filed and concluded; joint family properties divided by metes and bounds.
OR9217d22d06d5a113.procedure_and_court: Suit No. 23 of 1928 in Court of Subordinate Judge, Shahjahanpur.

ORa38a1398d21715da.content: On September 29, 1934, Mst. Naraini filed suit for recovery of Rs 12,500 against Baldev Das based on mortgage bond; plaintiff later abandoned claim against mortgaged property.
ORa38a1398d21715da.event: Suit filed for recovery; amended to seek money decree only against Baldev Das personally.
ORa38a1398d21715da.procedure_and_court: Suit in Court of Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

ORf57aff837a76ec44.content: Appellants applied to be added as parties defendants; court recorded order that legal representatives could not raise pleas on mortgage validity after plaintiff abandoned mortgage claim.
ORf57aff837a76ec44.event: Application to add parties dismissed; compromise reached; money decree passed against estate of Baldev Das.
ORf57aff837a76ec44.procedure_and_court: Proceedings in Court of Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

OR1f3b668380d93c0d.content: Decree holder filed execution application on March 13, 1945; court attached shops in possession of appellants at Abdullaput.
OR1f3b668380d93c0d.event: Execution application filed; properties attached; appellants filed objections under section 47.
OR1f3b668380d93c0d.procedure_and_court: Execution Case No. 18 of 1945 in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

ORb8b0267dfa6ee45b.content: Subordinate Judge held partition occurred in 1928; properties attached were allotted to sons; debt was pre-partition but not immoral; execution against sons' share permitted under Hindu law and section 53 of Civil Procedure Code.
ORb8b0267dfa6ee45b.event: Objections under section 47 dismissed; appeal to High Court dismissed; further appeal to Letters Patent Bench dismissed.
ORb8b0267dfa6ee45b.procedure_and_court: Execution proceedings in Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala; appeals to High Court of East Punjab.

OR8e2eef92fe67ac57.content: Appellants contend decree-holder can proceed only against Baldev Das's properties; sons' separate property not liable; pious obligation enforceable only in suit, not execution.
OR8e2eef92fe67ac57.event: Appellants raise three-fold contention in support of appeal against execution of decree.
OR8e2eef92fe67ac57.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 before Supreme Court.

ORcc74561bf687b691.content: No formal compromise petition filed; two statements on record set out terms of compromise; decree passed against estate of Baldev Das deceased in possession of legal representatives.
ORcc74561bf687b691.event: Compromise terms recorded; decree passed in accordance with compromise against estate of Baldev Das.
ORcc74561bf687b691.procedure_and_court: Proceedings in Court of Senior Subordinate Judge, Ambala.

OR91afff2206e8d14a.content: Expression 'estate of Baldev Das deceased' refers to property belonging to Baldev Das at date of death; cannot include sons' partitioned property obtained during father's lifetime.
OR91afff2206e8d14a.event: Argument that decree does not cover sons' partitioned property.
OR91afff2206e8d14a.procedure_and_court: Civil Appeal No. 57 of 1951 before Supreme Court.
